whatIs.title: What is OCR?
whatIs.content: OCR stands for Optical Character Recognition. It's a technology that allows software to analyze images and detect letters, numbers, and symbols to transform them into searchable and editable digital content.

how.title: How it works
how.content: OCR software scans the pixel patterns of an image, identifies shapes as characters, and uses language models to reconstruct sentences and paragraphs.

apps.title: Applications
apps.content: Widely used in business automation, digitization of archives, and assistive technologies for the visually impaired.
